email.title: Amazon Associates Email
email.description: The email address used to log in to Amazon Associates.

password.title: Amazon Associates Password
password.description: The password for your Amazon Associates account.

otpSecret.title: OTP / 2FA Code (optional)
otpSecret.description: If your account uses two-factor authentication, supply the current TOTP code here. Leave blank if 2FA is not enabled.

creatorId.title: Creator ID (optional)
creatorId.description: Your Amazon creator ID (e.g. amzn1.creator.xxxx). Leave blank and the scraper will auto-detect it from the page after login. You can find it in the URL when you visit the Creator Connections page in your browser.

maxCampaigns.title: Max Campaigns to Scrape
maxCampaigns.description: Maximum number of Creator Connections campaigns to scrape. Set to 0 for unlimited.

scrapeAsinDetails.title: Scrape ASIN Details
scrapeAsinDetails.description: When enabled, the scraper clicks into each campaign to collect the full ASIN list and product details. Slower but more thorough.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxies are recommended to avoid Amazon bot-detection.

categories.title: Category Filter (optional)
categories.description: Only return campaigns that match one or more of these category keywords. Matching is case-insensitive and checks the campaign title, description, brand name, and any category label on the card. Leave empty to return all categories. Examples: ["womens fashion", "supplements", "beauty", "electronics"].

sessionCookies.title: Session Cookies (optional)
sessionCookies.description: Pre-authenticated cookies exported from your browser. Supply these to skip the login flow. Each item should be a Playwright/Puppeteer cookie object.
